exactText: Even under the best circumstances, the transition to this new AI era will be one of the most turbulent times in human history.
sourceQuote: the transition to this new AI era will be one of the most turbulent times in human history.
normalizedClaim: The transition to the AI era will rank among the most turbulent periods in human history.
resolutionCriteria: Historical and sociological assessments by 2040 ranking the 2025–2040 AI transition alongside major upheavals such as the Industrial Revolution or world wars in terms of societal disruption.

normalizedClaim: AI will cause many existing job categories to disappear permanently.
resolutionCriteria: Occupational employment statistics (BLS or equivalent) showing permanent elimination or near-elimination of multiple significant job categories due to AI by 2035.

exactText: It will hit these industries rapidly, over the course of a decade rather than a few generations.
sourceQuote: It will hit these industries rapidly, over the course of a decade rather than a few generations.
normalizedClaim: AI-driven job displacement in white-collar and subsequently blue-collar industries will occur over roughly one decade.
resolutionCriteria: Significant measurable displacement in sales, customer support, software, legal, medical, manufacturing, construction, and hospitality roles concentrated between 2026 and 2036.

exactText: I think “smart” robots will begin to compete with people on some physical tasks—in the construction and hospitality industries, for example—by the end of the decade.
sourceQuote: “smart” robots will begin to compete with people on some physical tasks—in the construction and hospitality industries, for example—by the end of the decade.
normalizedClaim: Smart robots will begin competing with humans on physical tasks in construction and hospitality by around 2030.
resolutionCriteria: Commercial deployment of robots performing economically relevant physical tasks in construction or hospitality at scale by 2030, documented by industry reports.

exactText: I believe that as AI and robots improve, we’ll set aside certain things for only people to do.
sourceQuote: we’ll set aside certain things for only people to do.
normalizedClaim: Society will deliberately reserve certain jobs or tasks exclusively for humans (“human-reserved” domain).
resolutionCriteria: Enactment of policies, regulations, or widespread institutional practices designating specific roles as human-only by 2035.

exactText: AI will either be the greatest equalizer ever invented, or the worst source of injustice.
sourceQuote: AI will either be the greatest equalizer ever invented, or the worst source of injustice.
normalizedClaim: AI’s long-term impact will be either the greatest equalizer or the worst source of injustice in history, depending on choices made now.
resolutionCriteria: Long-term inequality metrics (Gini coefficients, global income shares) and access to AI benefits showing either dramatic equalization or exacerbation of disparities by 2040.

exactText: With the right investments and policies in place, over the next ten years we will have new affordable zero-carbon technologies ready to roll out at scale.
sourceQuote: over the next ten years we will have new affordable zero-carbon technologies ready to roll out at scale.
normalizedClaim: By approximately 2035, new affordable zero-carbon technologies will be ready for large-scale deployment.
resolutionCriteria: Commercial availability and cost-competitiveness of zero-carbon solutions for hard-to-abate sectors by 2035, per IEA or Breakthrough Energy reports.

exactText: There will be some new jobs, but without the right policies there will be far fewer than exist today.
sourceQuote: without the right policies there will be far fewer than exist today.
normalizedClaim: Without appropriate policies, the net number of jobs after AI displacement will be substantially lower than current levels.
resolutionCriteria: Net employment in AI-exposed economies declining or stagnating relative to pre-AI baselines by 2035 if major redistributive or transition policies are not enacted.

exactText: We overestimate what AI will do in two years and underestimate what it will do in ten.
sourceQuote: We overestimate what AI will do in two years and underestimate what it will do in ten.
normalizedClaim: Short-term (2-year) expectations for AI impact are overstated while 10-year impacts are understated.
resolutionCriteria: Comparison of actual AI capability and economic impact in 2028 versus 2036 relative to 2026 forecasts, showing larger cumulative change over the longer horizon.

exactText: If the world takes the right steps, AI will be a force for good and leave everyone better off.
sourceQuote: If the world takes the right steps, AI will be a force for good and leave everyone better off.
normalizedClaim: With proper governance and policy, AI can produce net positive outcomes that improve conditions for everyone.
resolutionCriteria: Global welfare metrics (health, education, income floors) showing broad-based improvement attributable to AI by 2040 under observed policy regimes.
